I'd welcome the chance to talk.

cover_letter:
Dear hiring team at Dignify,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Automation Consultant position at your Genk hub. I'll start with the honest part: I haven't yet worked hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Bloomreach, Selligent or Braze. What I do have is the technical base those platforms sit on, and a record of teaching myself whatever a project needs.

I build and maintain websites end to end — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress — and I write the content and campaigns that run on them. At Knowledge Experts I supported SharePoint-based platforms for ŞOK Market, a retailer with 4,000+ stores and ERP/POS integration, and for Aras Kargo, where an application gallery served 12,000 staff. Those projects showed me how customer data moves between systems and how to turn a business requirement into something that ships. Earlier, as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor, I worked in JavaScript on a healthcare application.

Today I work freelance and at Episto on SEO, content and web, using GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to segment audiences, personalise pages and report on what works. I automate repetitive work with Python and MCP integrations into WordPress, and I have an Android app live on Google Play.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, fluent in English, with Turkish as my native language. What appeals to me about Dignify is the depth: enterprise clients in retail, publishing, travel and healthcare, a team of 85+ specialists, and training and certification built into the role. I want to grow into marketing automation properly, surrounded by people who have done it for years.

I'd be glad to talk about how my web, data and automation background could serve your clients.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
